summary: AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR for external databases on every default component: `spec.database.database_secret` for platform gateway, `controller.postgres_configuration_secret`, `hub.postgres_configuration_secret` and `eda.database.database_secret`.
questions: How do I point all AAP operator components at an external PostgreSQL?
Which CR fields set the external database secret for controller, hub and EDA?
external-postgres-configuration secret names in AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR

answer_card.title: External databases for all components in the CR
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatform
metadata:
  name: myaap
spec:
  database:
    database_secret: external-postgres-configuration-gateway
  controller:
    postgres_configuration_secret: external-postgres-configuration-controller
  hub:
    postgres_configuration_secret: external-postgres-configuration-hub
  eda:
    database:
      database_secret: external-postgres-configuration-eda
```
Note that EDA nests the secret under `database:` like the gateway, while controller and hub use `postgres_configuration_secret`.
